# agents.AgentCatalogEntry

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A subagent available to an organization with its enabled state, tools and skills.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.AgentCatalogEntry` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.agent-settings.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | yes | `none` | What the agent does. |  |
| `enabled` | yes | `none` | Whether the supervisor may delegate to it in this organization. |  |
| `key` | yes | `none` | Agent key used in agent-settings.enabledAgents. |  |
| `moduleId` | yes | `none` | Module that ships the agent; null for core agents. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Display name of the agent. |  |
| `skills` | yes | `none` | Skills attached to the agent in this organization. |  |
| `source` | yes | `none` | Shipped with the core or with an installed module. |  |
| `tools` | yes | `none` | Tools the agent has in this organization, connector tools included. |  |
